items.title: Polars 2.0 speeds larger workloads
items.oneliner: DataFrame engine adds out-of-core execution and stronger SQL, with benchmarks beating DuckDB and DataFusion on TPC workloads.

items.title: Mold 3.0 is now Rust
items.oneliner: Drop-in Linux linker rewritten in Rust, keeping mold speed while closing GNU ld compatibility gaps.

items.title: openTPU exposes full AI accelerator stack
items.oneliner: Clone a complete open AI accelerator with SystemVerilog, compiler, simulator, and benchmarks for 10 modern models.

items.title: PhotoCraft replaces Photoshop workflows offline
items.oneliner: Rust image editor opens real PSD files with layers and masks, giving artists a local open-source Photoshop alternative.

items.title: Montray watches systemd from your tray
items.oneliner: Linux tray app blinks when systemd services fail, with remote monitoring and custom command health checks.

items.title: Mailcheck audits mailserver security quickly
items.oneliner: Go CLI verifies SMTP, MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, TLS, and DNSSEC, then exits cleanly for Nagios or Icinga.

items.title: Zig can extend Lua today
items.oneliner: Hands-on tutorial shows how to install Zig and expose a first native function inside Lua.

items.title: Parseable handles huge telemetry volumes
items.oneliner: Open observability data lake ingests 100 million time-series per minute with SQL, PromQL, dashboards, and alerts.

items.title: Kahawai self-hosts your media stack
items.oneliner: Rust media server streams films and music from one binary, using SQLite and built-in transcoding.

items.title: Tapo now supports TP-Link TPAP
items.oneliner: Rust and Python library regains newer Tapo device access without the old third-party compatibility switch.
